rawFindings.title: Incorrect skipping of Export declarations in statement count
rawFindings.explanation: The updated regex SINGLE_CHILD_ALLOWED includes 'ExportDefaultDeclaration' and 'ExportNamedDeclaration', causing export declarations to be incorrectly skipped from statement counting. This breaks enforcement of max statements per line for export declarations containing multiple statements on the same line, leading to missed reports.
rawFindings.suggestion: Remove 'Export(?:Default|Named)Declaration' from the SINGLE_CHILD_ALLOWED regex so that export declarations are properly counted and reported if exceeding max statements per line.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For example, the code `export default function foo() { console.log('test'); console.log('test2'); }` on one line will not be reported, but it should be reported as exceeding the max statements per line limit.
